text:
maria: Heads up — noticed sensitive fields (email, phone) are not redacted in logs from the node sampleapp when LOG_LEVEL=debug. Seems tied to reqid propagation: multiple requests get the same reqid sometimes.

sam: ugh. seen this before with async_hooks + a lib that patches execution context. Which node runtime?

maria: node 18.16 in Docker (linux). Repro steps: run sampleapp with concurrency 50 and tail logs, you can see duplicate reqids and then unredacted payload lines right after stack traces.

lee: can you paste the log snippet? and the start of your middleware chain? order matters for our otel hook.

maria: snippet:```
[2026-03-22T09:12:03Z] INFO reqid=abc123 route=/v1/generate payload={"email":"alice@example.com","text":"hi"}
[2026-03-22T09:12:03Z] INFO reqid=abc123 auth=ok stack="Error: boom at handler"
[2026-03-22T09:12:03Z] DEBUG reqid=abc123 redactor=skipped payload={"phone":"+15551234"}
```

maria: middleware order (index.js):```js
app.use(require('./reqid'))
app.use(require('./otel-hook'))
app.use(require('./redactor'))
```

ash: if redactor runs after otel-hook and otel-hook is breaking context, the reqid from reqid middleware may get lost and be reattached incorrectly. try swapping otel-hook to run first or run redactor earlier as a quick test.

sam: also check for any 3rd-party lib that calls asyncLocalStorage.run/enterWith. That will stomp ours. We had a case with somemetrics@^2.3 doing that.

lee: minimal fix: in reqid middleware use:```js
const als = require('./als')
als.run(new Map([['reqid', reqid]]), () => next())
```
but make sure no other part uses enterWith.

jen: QA can repro — I ran the concurrency script and saw same. If we patch middleware order, what are the rollout plans? we should test in staging with sampleapp before any backport.

maria: created quick PR that changes hook order + adds a defensive check in redactor: if (!reqid) regenerate and tag as volatile-reqid. PR: #1217. Put repro script in /scripts/repro-reqid.sh.

sam: nice. small nit: rather than regenerate silently, log a one-off metric for volatile-reqid so Optimize can alert.

ash: temporary mitigation: set LOG_LEVEL=info on Dedicated to stop debug payloads from showing until patch lands. run: `kubectl set env deploy/sampleapp LOG_LEVEL=info -n dedicated`

telemetry-bot: deploy sampleapp/staging v1.4.7 -> success :white_check_mark: (build 8842)

maria: thanks. I'll add metric + tests. tagging @sam @lee for review.

sam: will review today. if all good we'll backport to 1.3.x patch release. :thumbsup:

jen: QA will smoke in staging once PR merged and will run the concurrency script and verify no leaked emails/phones.

lee: follow-up: add an e2e that asserts every log line has either a redacted payload or matches regex for info-only. saves future regressions.

maria: agreed. adding e2e and changelog note re: OTEL hook ordering.

ash: fyi — leaving LOG_LEVEL change scheduled for 2 hours unless PR lands earlier.

sam: thanks everyone. great catch, maria.
